Second, depend on nothing in the session, no attached packages and no options. Third, record exactly what the report ran on.

text: Line two builds the path from the data directory argument with file dot path, so the working directory no longer matters. Every call outside base R carries its package prefix, so nothing depends on what happens to be attached. Missing outcomes are dropped first, so n counts only real values, and each statistic is computed per arm. The label uses sprint F, which always prints a decimal point, unlike format, which follows the session's options.
